conviction_note: Management told investors on 2026-09-10 that Q3 was tracking ahead of its 17%-of-$27 (~$4.59) seasonality guide, so a beat (my read ~$4.95 vs $4.66 consensus) is likely, but the whisper ($4.95), a 9.1% 20-day run-up to a 52-week high and the July precedent (beat-and-raise sold -8.5%) mean the beat is largely expected; the sum of findings is slightly negative (-0.6) because positioning outweighs a partly priced beat, while p_up sits at 51 because the call's 2027 commentary, which nothing I found pins down, decides the sign. abs_move 7.0 follows the 7.63% option-implied event move, shaded slightly toward the 2.57% median.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS consensus $4.66 (Zacks; Earnings Whispers https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/ELV), $4.69-4.70 (Benzinga https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ELV/earnings-forecasts; GuruFocus), revenue $48.5-49.2B; whisper $4.95. Company guide: Q3 adj EPS ~17% of FY guide of at least $27.00 = ~$4.59 (Q2 call, https://s202.q4cdn.com/665319960/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/ELV-USQ_Transcript_2026-07-15.pdf). FY2026 adj EPS at least $27.00, BER 90.2% +/-50bp reaffirmed 2026-09-10 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001156039/000115603926000063/elv-20260910.htm). 2027: at least 12% growth off a >=$26 baseline (>= ~$29.12) vs street ~$29.4-29.5 (TIKR, single secondary source).
positioning_check: Short interest 4,854,598 shares at 2026-09-30 settlement, about 2.24% of shares outstanding, 3.92 days to cover, down from 5.59M at 2026-07-31 (https://equibles.com/stocks/elv/shortinterest). Not a crowded short. 25-delta skew +0.85 vol points (balanced), put/call OI 1.05, event-implied move 7.63%. Tape: spot 438.995 at its 52-week high, +3.23% over 5 days, +9.09% over 20 days, about +24.5% YTD (GuruFocus, 2026-10-20), and +15% since the post-Q2 close of ~$381.62. The spot sits at the July consensus price target of $439.57 (Baird note coverage, longbridge.com).

findings.finding: At the Wells Fargo healthcare conference on 2026-09-10, management said Q3 2026 adjusted EPS was 'tracking ahead of prior expectations' on favorable benefit expense. It also said Medicare Advantage was ahead of expectations, the Medicaid BER and margin were tracking slightly ahead of the full-year outlook (-1.75% margin) on July rate actions, and individual ACA was modestly better on slower bronze cost emergence. The 'prior expectation' was the Q2-call guide of Q3 at about 17% of $27, roughly $4.59. Consensus is $4.66-4.70 and the whisper $4.95, so the street has moved only partway to a beat. My read is about $4.95, +6% vs consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ELV has beaten consensus in each of the last four quarters. The reactions were mixed: Q2 2026 beat ($7.45 vs $6.18) with a raise to >=$27 went -8.54% (sold on the quality of the beat, a $0.80 below-the-line gain and operating margin down to 3.6%); Q1 2026 beat ($12.58 vs $11.03) with a raise went +0.03%; Q4 2025 went +5.86%; Q3 2025 went -1.22%. Beats on this name are not reliably paid.
findings.why_not_priced: If this were fully priced, consensus would sit near the whisper ($4.95) rather than $4.66, and Zacks would not show one downward and no upward revision in 60 days. It is partly priced: the stock is +9% in 20 days and at its 52-week high, and the whisper is $0.29 over consensus, so the buy side expects a beat.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-10 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001156039/000115603926000063/elv-20260910.htm) reaffirms FY >= $27 and BER 90.2% +/-50bp but says nothing on Q3. The 17% seasonality comes from the Q2 transcript, a different document. The UNH read-through (next finding) is a separate source pointing the same way.

findings.finding: UnitedHealth reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-13, after ELV last spoke. Its MCR was 88.4% vs 89.9% a year earlier and vs about 89.9% expected, and adjusted EPS was $4.69 vs $4.12-4.15 consensus. It raised FY adj EPS to at least $20.50 from $19.50-20.00. The MCR includes $610M of favorable 2026 reserve development, and Medicaid membership fell 85k on eligibility changes. For the industry, Q3 cost trend did not deteriorate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No ELV-specific history on peer read-throughs found. On ELV's own Q2 print, peers moved in sympathy (CNC -4.9%, HUM -1.7%), so the group trades together on cost-trend news.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: ELV's +3.2% over 5 days and +9.1% over 20 days span this print, and UNH itself rose only about 3%. What is left is that consensus on ELV ($4.66) has not visibly moved up since. If the read-through were fully in estimates, the Zacks revision count would show upward moves.
findings.independence: XTB coverage of the same release (https://www.xtb.com/int/market-analysis/news-and-research/unitedhealth-group-shares-gain-3-after-stronger-than-expected-earnings-and-guidance). It is a proxy: UNH's mix (Optum, a much smaller Medicaid share) differs from ELV, and part of the MCR beat is prior-period development.

findings.finding: The beat is crowded into the price. Spot of $439 is at its 52-week high and at the July consensus price target of $439.57. It is +9.1% in 20 days, about +24.5% YTD and +15% since the post-Q2 close of ~$381.62. The Earnings Whispers whisper is $4.95, $0.29 above the $4.66 consensus. In July, a larger beat ($7.45 vs $6.18) with a raise was sold -8.5% on beat quality. That leaves a bar where an in-line beat or another 'at least' raise can be sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: beat and raise into a stock trading near highs, -8.54%. Q3 2025: beat, -1.22%. Two of the last four prints with beats closed flat to down.
findings.why_not_priced: This finding is a reading of what IS priced. The option market does not lean: skew is +0.85, balanced, so it is not paying for the downside this implies. Short interest is low (2.24%, 3.9 days), so no squeeze cushions a disappointment.
findings.independence: Run-up and 52-week-high status from the sealed baseline tape. YTD figure from GuruFocus (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9132075/elevance-health-elv-set-to-report-q3-earnings-on-october-21). Post-Q2 price from Simply Wall St (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/healthcare/nyse-elv/elevance-health/news/elevance-health-elv-raises-2026-targets-and-exits-weak-medic/amp).

findings.finding: The street's 2027 EPS, about $29.4-29.5 per TIKR, already sits above management's stated floor of at least 12% growth off a >=$26 2026 baseline, about $29.12. The Q3 call is the usual venue for early 2027 framing, with Medicaid work requirements from 2027, ACA risk-pool shifts after the subsidy expiry, and 2027 MA bids. A reiteration of 'at least 12%' without lifting the baseline would leave the street above the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 call framed 2026 Medicaid cost pressure; stock -1.22%. Q2 2026: the raise came with a $26 'baseline' below the $27 headline, and the stock went -8.54%.
findings.why_not_priced: The bar is a single secondary source and undated, so this is capped small. If the market expected a lift in the baseline, the 2027 consensus would already sit well above $29.12. It sits only marginally above, so the gap is small either way.
findings.independence: The $26 baseline and 12% are in the Q2 transcript (https://s202.q4cdn.com/665319960/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/ELV-USQ_Transcript_2026-07-15.pdf). The street number has no second source.

findings.finding: Elevance's 2027 Medicare Advantage star ratings, released by CMS on 2026-10-08, fell: the unweighted average went from 3.59 to 3.51. Elevance is also suing CMS over its 2026 ratings for five contracts, which it says cost about $115M in 2027 quality bonus payments. The payment effect lands in 2027-2028 and could be raised on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No ELV print reaction found tied to stars.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 2026-10-08, and the stock rose afterwards, so it is mostly priced. What remains is any 2028 revenue quantification on the call.
findings.independence: Becker's summary of the 2027 ratings (https://www.beckerspayer.com/?p=29667). UNH also reported its 2027 stars as 'in line' (69% in 4+), so the decline is industry-wide.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call, management said it expects to exit additional Medicaid markets over the next 12-18 months where it sees no path to sustainable margins (DC already agreed), with Medicaid at about $57B of revenue run-rate. The Q3 call may name or size exits, which would lower revenue but improve margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No ELV print reaction found on Medicaid exits specifically.
findings.why_not_priced: The intent is public. What is not public is which markets and how big, and the call is the likely place it surfaces. Small either way.
findings.independence: Simply Wall St summary of exits (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/healthcare/nyse-elv/elevance-health/news/elevance-health-elv-raises-2026-targets-and-exits-weak-medic/amp). Same underlying document.

outside_window.finding: Molina Healthcare reports Q3 2026 after the close on 2026-10-21 (call 2026-10-22). It is a Medicaid read-through that lands after ELV's exit window closes.

rejected_candidates.detail: Any thesis of residual sanctions risk at this print is contradicted by the Q2 transcript: the matter was closed on 2026-07-09 and the exposure estimate was unchanged. Nothing new lands in the window.

rejected_candidates.detail: The pledge dates from January 2026 and was restated in UNH's Q3 release (already part of the UNH finding). Nothing new on ELV.

rejected_candidates.detail: Announced 2026-02-26 and already absorbed through two prints. Kept here only for completeness; nothing lands in the window.

baseline_tension: The fundamental evidence (Q3 tracking ahead, UNH's benign cost trend) agrees with the 9% run-up and the whisper, so it is mostly in the price. The balanced skew (+0.85) does not lean either way, which leaves the reaction to the 2027 framing and the size of the FY raise.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction), with rule 6 (Q3 beat is what management told investors to expect on 2026-09-10): Q3-tracking-ahead finding cut from +1.2 to +0.8; p_up from 52 to 51
Rule 5 (proxy smaller): UNH read-through cut from +0.5 to +0.4, since UNH's mix differs and part of its MCR beat is prior-period development
Stars finding cut from -0.2 to -0.1: public since 2026-10-08 and the payment impact is in 2027-2028
Rule 7 checked: short interest 2.24% and 3.9 days to cover, skew balanced, so the -1.5 positioning finding stands unchanged

Rule 6 bar check: the bar is sourced to the company's 17% seasonality guide plus three agreeing estimate sources, so no cap applies to the Q3 finding; the 2027 bar has one secondary source and stays capped small at -0.3
